```{python}
#|output: false
# Setup code
import pandas as pd
from python_scripts import setup
from python_scripts import services
from python_scripts import helper
from python_scripts import routes
df, dffp = setup.setup(verbose=False)

from python_scripts import distinct_pathways
dpw_pls = distinct_pathways.get_distinct_pathways_routes(dffp)
qrows = dpw_pls["rt_end_cat"] == "[Not ended or invalid end reason]"
dpw_pls.loc[dpw_pls.pl_end_dt > distinct_pathways.dpw_end_dt, ["pl_end_dt", "pl_end_reason", "dur"]] = pd.NA
dpw_pls.loc[qrows, "rt_end_cat"] = dpw_pls.loc[qrows, "pl_end_dt"].isna().map({True: "[Not ended]", False: "Missing data/error"})
dpw_pls["rt_end_cat"] = dpw_pls["rt_end_cat"].str.replace("To care/hosp.", "To care/hospital")
dpw_rt_starts = dpw_pls.groupby("route_id").head(1)
dpw_rt_ends = dpw_pls.groupby("route_id").tail(1)
dpw_clis = dpw_pls.groupby(["o_cli_id"]).head(1)  # 1 duplicate client but first entry has more detailed answers


import matplotlib
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
matplotlib.rcParams.update({
    'figure.figsize': (6, 9.5),
    'font.size': 12,
    'figure.constrained_layout.use': True
})

asset_themes = {"opaque": "assets_output/",
                "transparent_lightbg": "assets_transparent_lightbg/",
                "transparent_darkbg": "assets_transparent_darkbg/"}
assets_output = asset_themes["opaque"]
output_dir = assets_output
```

```{python}
periodMult = {"d": 1, "m": 365.25/12, "y": 365.25}
years = periodMult["y"]
time_measure = pd.Timedelta(days=(3.08 * years))
dpw_rt_ends = dpw_pls.groupby("route_id").tail(1)
dpw_rt_ends = dpw_rt_ends.set_index("route_id", drop=False)
end_cols_to_drop = dpw_rt_ends.columns[
    (
        dpw_rt_ends.columns.isin(["gap", "dur"])
        | dpw_rt_ends.columns.str.startswith("prev_")
        | dpw_rt_ends.columns.str.startswith("vac_")
        | dpw_rt_ends.columns.str.startswith("pl_")
    )].to_list()
end_cols_to_drop.remove("pl_end_reason")
dpw_routes = dpw_rt_ends.drop(columns=end_cols_to_drop)
dpw_routes["rt_start_dt"] = dpw_rt_starts.set_index("route_id")["pl_start_dt"].rename("rt_start_dt")
dpw_routes["rt_end_dt"] = dpw_rt_ends["pl_end_dt"].rename("rt_end_dt")
# Set up map from categories to outcomes
rt_outcomes_map = {
    'Independent accommodation': ['To social housing', 'To private rented'],
    'Insecure outcome': ['To friends/family', 'Custody', '[Not ended]', 'To care/hospital', 'To external supported'],
    'Returned to homelessness': ['Evicted', 'Abandoned'],
    'Died': ['Died'],
    # '_excluded': ['Other', 'Missing data/error']
}
rt_end_cat_map = {cat: outcome for outcome in rt_outcomes_map.keys() for cat in rt_outcomes_map[outcome]}
dpw_rt_outcomes = dpw_routes[
    # Only include routes where there has been long enough for the outcome to happen
    (dpw_routes["rt_start_dt"] <= distinct_pathways.dpw_end_dt - time_measure)
    # Only include routes that have a rt_end_cat that corresponds to an outcome
    & (dpw_routes["rt_end_cat"].isin(rt_end_cat_map.keys()))]
dpw_rt_outcomes["rt_outcome"] = dpw_rt_outcomes["rt_end_cat"].map(rt_end_cat_map)
dpw_pl_endreason = (dpw_rt_outcomes["pl_end_reason"].astype("string")
                    .str.replace(r" \([Pp]lanned\)$| \(Unplanned\)$|^\(A\&A\) |^\(FS\) ", "", regex=True)
                    .where(dpw_rt_outcomes["rt_end_dt"] <= dpw_rt_outcomes["rt_start_dt"] + time_measure,
                           other="[Not ended]")
                    .copy())
dpw_rt_end_cat = (dpw_rt_outcomes["rt_end_cat"].astype("string")
                    .where(dpw_rt_outcomes["rt_end_dt"] <= dpw_rt_outcomes["rt_start_dt"] + time_measure,
                           other="[Not ended]")
                    .copy())
dpw_rt_outcomes_0  = (dpw_rt_outcomes["rt_outcome"].astype("string")
                    .where(dpw_rt_outcomes["rt_end_dt"] <= dpw_rt_outcomes["rt_start_dt"] + time_measure,
                           other="[Not ended]")
                    .copy())
# Still being in supported accommodation is generally an insecure outcome
dpw_rt_outcomes.loc[
    (dpw_rt_outcomes["rt_end_dt"] > (dpw_rt_outcomes["rt_start_dt"] + time_measure)),
    "rt_outcome"] = "Insecure outcome"
# But being in level 3 or 4 of the homelessness pathways in self-contained (not shared)
# means having your own flat with support staff occasionally visiting, i.e. similar
# to independent accommdoation
dpw_rt_timemeasure_dt = (dpw_rt_outcomes["rt_start_dt"] + time_measure).rename("rt_timemeasure_dt")
rt_pls = dpw_pls.join(dpw_rt_timemeasure_dt, on="route_id", how="inner")
rt_pls_at_timemeasures = rt_pls[(rt_pls["pl_start_dt"] < rt_pls["rt_timemeasure_dt"])
                                & (
                                    rt_pls["pl_end_dt"].isna()
                                    | (rt_pls["pl_end_dt"] > rt_pls["rt_timemeasure_dt"])
                                )].set_index("route_id")
dpw_rt_outcomes.loc[
    (dpw_rt_outcomes["rt_end_dt"] > (dpw_rt_outcomes["rt_start_dt"] + time_measure))
    & (rt_pls_at_timemeasures["pathway_level"].isin(["3", "4"]))
    & (rt_pls_at_timemeasures["shared"] == "No"),
    "rt_outcome"] = "Independent accommodation"
dpw_rt_outcomes_1 = dpw_rt_outcomes["rt_outcome"].rename("rt_outcome_lt").copy()

cols = [dpw_pl_endreason, dpw_rt_end_cat, dpw_rt_outcomes_0, dpw_rt_outcomes_1]
outcome_classification = pd.concat(cols, axis=1).value_counts().reset_index()
order_grp = []
for x in outcome_classification.columns[:-1]:
    order_grp.append(outcome_classification.groupby(x)["count"].transform("sum").rename(x))
order_df = pd.concat(order_grp, axis=1)
order_df = order_df.sort_values(list(reversed(order_df.columns)), ascending=False)
outcome_classification = outcome_classification.loc[order_df.index]
outcome_classification = outcome_classification.replace({"Independent accommodation": "Independent accom.",
                                                         "Custody - Court Hearing/Arrest Warrant for Prior Offence": "Custody - As Result Of Prior Offence"})
```

```{python}
import plotly.graph_objects as go
import numpy as np
import seaborn as sns
sns.set()

unique_outcomes = pd.concat([outcome_classification[x].to_frame().stack().drop_duplicates().reset_index(1)
                             for x in ["pl_end_reason", "rt_end_cat", "rt_outcome", "rt_outcome_lt"]],
                            ignore_index=True).rename(columns={"level_1": "col", 0: "outcome"})
val_dicts = (outcome_classification.groupby("rt_outcome_lt")["count"].sum().reset_index()
             .apply(lambda x: {x["rt_outcome_lt"]: x["rt_outcome_lt"] + f" ({x["count"]:,})"}, axis=1))
val_dict = {k: v for d in val_dicts for k, v in d.items()}
outcome_labels = unique_outcomes.copy()
outcome_labels.loc[outcome_labels["col"] == "rt_outcome_lt", "outcome"] = (
    outcome_labels.loc[outcome_labels["col"] == "rt_outcome_lt", "outcome"].replace(val_dict))
node_labels = outcome_labels["outcome"]
node_labels.loc[34] = ""
colours = sns.color_palette(n_colors=len(unique_outcomes))
colours = np.round([[x*256 for x in colour] for colour in colours]).astype("int")
colours = [f"rgba({r},{g},{b},0.7)" for r, g, b in colours]
outcome_idx = unique_outcomes.reset_index().set_index(["col", "outcome"])
link_grp = (outcome_classification.drop(columns="count")
            .stack().rename("outcome").reset_index(1).rename(columns={"level_1": "col"})
            .join(outcome_idx, on=["col", "outcome"]).drop(columns="outcome")
            .pivot(columns="col", values="index"))
link_grp["value"] = outcome_classification["count"]
source = []
target = []
value = []
colour = []
for a, b in [("pl_end_reason", "rt_end_cat"),
             ("rt_end_cat", "rt_outcome"),
             ("rt_outcome", "rt_outcome_lt")]:
    comparison = link_grp.groupby([a, b])["value"].sum().reset_index()
    source += comparison[a].to_list()
    target += comparison[b].to_list()
    value += comparison["value"].to_list()
    colour += comparison[b].apply(lambda x: colours[x] if x!= 21 else colours[0]).to_list()

fig = go.Figure(data=[go.Sankey(
    node=dict(
      pad=15,
      thickness=20,
      line=dict(color="black", width=0.5),
      label=node_labels,
      color=colours[0]
    ),
    link=dict(source=source, target=target, value=value, color=colour)
)])

fig.update_layout(title=dict(text="Mapping of route outcomes into grouped categories", x=0.5, xanchor="center"), font_family="Arial")
fig.write_image(assets_output + "Figure_11.1.svg", width=1050, height=650)
fig.show()
```
